jobs.eligibility_reason: Virtual teaching role, no age restriction indicated.

jobs.title: Administrative / Clerical / Customer Service - Talent Pool
jobs.why: This role builds your Instructing, Active Learning, Critical Thinking skills and moves you toward becoming a Teacher.
jobs.eligibility_reason: Administrative/clerical/customer service roles are suitable for ages 16-20.
jobs.bridge: Your administrative role sharpens your organization, communication, and active listening skills—directly transferable to managing a classroom or counseling youth. Mastering calendar and email management now builds the time-management and multitasking abilities you'll need to juggle lesson plans or student schedules.

steps: Take a free online data-entry course to build accuracy and speed.
Volunteer for administrative tasks at a school or youth center to practice administrative-support and calendar-management.
Enroll in a workshop on behavior intervention plans (BIPs) to understand student support strategies.
Learn basic budgeting for classroom or program resources via a short course.
Shadow a teacher or youth counselor to observe classroom management and teaching techniques.
